title: Exemplar-based objective classification of gust-induced loads across multiple flight conditions
abstract: arXiv:2608.12448v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Is it possible to find an objective classification criterion that organizes the complexity of gust-induced loads across many flight conditions? And one that remains as interpretable as a labelling based on coarse parameters, such as the flight attitude? Our approach encodes a large number of experimental observations through a machine-learned representation and applies a summarization procedure to select a minimal subset of highly significant exemplars. The exemplars provide a similarity-based objective classification criterion of all the observations, they can be more conveniently inspected by experts and can become subject of more refined experiments. We demonstrate the approach on a database of 3480 pressure-load measurements induced by random gusts on a flying-wing model across six flight attitudes. translated_title: 基于范例的多飞行条件下阵风载荷客观分类
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12448v1 公告类型：新  摘要：是否有可能找到一个客观的分类标准，来组织多种飞行条件下阵风载荷的复杂性？并且这个标准能像基于粗略参数（如飞行姿态）的标签一样保持可解释性？我们的方法通过机器学习表示编码大量实验观测，并应用摘要程序选择最小子集的高度显著范例。这些范例为所有观测提供了基于相似性的客观分类标准，它们可以更方便地被专家检查，并可能成为更精细实验的对象。我们在一个包含3480个压力载荷测量的数据库上展示了该方法，该数据库由随机阵风在六个飞行姿态下对飞翼模型诱导产生。我们发现了九种在多个姿态中重复出现的基本响应类型；对某一类型瞬态响应的分析能够实现物理解释。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于范例的客观分类方法，利用机器学习表示和摘要程序，从多飞行条件下阵风载荷数据中提取出九种可解释的基本响应类型，兼顾分类客观性与专家可检查性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an exemplar-based objective classification method that uses machine-learned representations and summarization to extract nine interpretable fundamental response types from gust-induced load data across multiple flight conditions, balancing objectivity with expert inspectability.
